intention: Mercy · stillness · the prayer of the heart
text:
Lord Jesus Christ, Son of God,
have mercy on me, a sinner.
meaning: A short prayer repeated on the breath, asking for mercy. In Greek it begins "Kyrie Iesou Christe".
purpose: To pray without ceasing, as a way of stillness.
when: On the breath, or with a prayer rope, at any time.
note: The prayer of the heart of Eastern Orthodox Christianity, taught in the Philokalia and widely practised in the West.
source: Eastern Orthodox Christian practice; wording as printed in the Wikipedia article on the Jesus Prayer
name: The Jesus Prayer
